model.commit_rule: candidate (r,k) commits iff W_r>=k, with deterministic early accept at k successes and early reject at r-k+1 failures

formulas.curtailed_discordant_stop_distribution: accept at n with C(n-1,k-1)p^k(1-p)^(n-k); reject at n with C(n-1,r-k)p^(n-r+k-1)(1-p)^(r-k+1)
formulas.q95: smallest N whose mixture CDF over exact total curtailed-discordance distribution is >=0.95

independent_recalculation.comparison_to_worker: Every listed mixed-policy q95, FWER and worst-position q=.60 commit probability matches the sealed worker checkpoint to displayed precision. Endpoint reference checks r10:k10 x20 -> q95 272/power 0.00593540513664163 and r50:k36 x8 + r50:k35 x12 -> q95 3389/power 0.053465547907689266 also match.

verdict.summary: The exact operating characteristics underlying the C15 mixed-depth headline are reproducible from the stated model and action sequences. In particular the budget-2000 policy (r30:k23 x18, r50:k36 x2) independently gives q95=1941, FWER=0.0484578202830 and worst-position q=.60 power=0.0416317335336, versus the sealed fixed-depth reference 0.0171830249964. The worker was also correct to avoid claiming a globally optimal Pareto frontier: this audit validates the listed policies' exact metrics, not that no better action sequence exists.
scope_corrections: Treat the roughly +142% to +197% mid-budget gains as gains of the listed observed policies versus the listed best fixed-depth references under the exact q=.60, rho=.20, 20-candidate model, not as a general property of mixed-depth sequential evaluation.
Do not promote the observed mixed-depth frontier to a certified global optimum until the proposed distribution-aware branch-and-bound/DP supplies an upper envelope or exhaustive certificate.
The q95 cost result assumes independent Bernoulli discordance arrivals with fixed rho=.20; variable/history-dependent discordance requires a separate analysis.

next_verification: Rotate to sealed C15 cross_field r72 and independently reproduce at least one exact conditional-SNML misalignment grid point plus its simultaneous Clopper-Pearson accounting if the predecessor identity is sufficient; otherwise prefer a different C15 raw-code claim rather than guessing missing formulas.
